decisions.decision: Move VIX and cross-asset context from I6 to two separate I4 plugins (VIXRegimePlugin + CrossAssetContextPlugin)
decisions.rationale: VIX is a macro regime signal (belongs in I4 with GARCH/HMM/Hurst), not cross-TF alignment (I6). Per-TF z-score was a data quality defect — same market moment produced different ctf_vix_z on 1m vs 1h bars. Two plugins not one: signal identity preservation principle (VIX=global, EQ=EQ_INDEX only).

decisions.decision: VIX_REGIME_TF='1h' fixed constant for VIX frame injection
decisions.rationale: 20 x 1h = 20 trading hours: captures session-scale fear elevation. Complementary to GARCH multi-week regime. Fixes the per-TF inconsistency where 1m bars saw 20-minute VIX z-score.
Function now captures I4 macro context (vix_level, vix_z, eq_spread_z, eq_pairs_confirming) + I6 confluence + exhaustion. Old name implied I6-only scope.
